news.titleEn: Scoop: Trump's top national security aides meet secretly at Camp David on Iran, Yemen
news.conclusionEn: Trump's top national security team, chaired by VP Vance, met for hours in an unannounced Camp David session to weigh next steps in the Iran war and the Saudi-Houthi conflict.
news.conclusionZh: 美国高层安全团队秘密齐聚戴维营，商讨伊朗战事与也门局势。
news.whyEn: The last such meeting came days before Israel's June 2025 war on Iran, so markets read it as a sign that renewed US strikes are a real possibility, with direct risk to oil and Hormuz shipping.
news.whyZh: 上次类似会议后数日即爆发以伊战争，市场担忧美国恢复对伊大规模打击，冲击油价。
news.detailEn: Rubio, Hegseth, Witkoff, CIA Director Ratcliffe, Gen. Caine and Treasury Secretary Bessent attended the meeting, which the White House did not announce. US-Iran talks have stalled since Trump rejected Tehran's seven-day proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for lifting the naval blockade and sanctions. One official said things were 'decided or at least deeply discussed.' Any decision to resume major combat would likely push oil and Treasury yields higher and weigh on risk assets.
news.detailZh: 出席者包括鲁比奥、赫格塞思、威特科夫、中情局局长拉特克利夫、参联会主席凯恩和财长贝森特，白宫未对外公布。特朗普拒绝伊朗「七天内重开霍尔木兹海峡、换取解除封锁和制裁」的提议后，美伊谈判陷入僵局。有官员称会上「作出了决定，或至少深入讨论过」。若美国决定恢复大规模作战，油价和美债收益率可能走高，风险资产承压。

news.titleEn: Stock futures are flat as investors grapple with higher yields, await Fed minutes: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: US stock futures opened flat for the new week as elevated Treasury yields and oil prices keep investors cautious ahead of Wednesday's Fed minutes.
news.conclusionZh: 美股期货开盘持平，投资者受高收益率困扰，静待美联储会议纪要。
news.whyEn: After a weak September jobs report (just 29,000 jobs added, unemployment at 4.2%), the Fed minutes will shape expectations for whether the central bank's next move is a hike or a hold.
news.whyZh: 9月仅新增2.9万个就业、失业率升至4.2%，纪要将左右市场对美联储下一步加息与否的判断。
news.detailEn: Higher yields and oil near $90 have weighed on equities as the Iran war keeps inflation risks elevated. Markets now price only about an 18-20% chance of an October rate hike after the soft payrolls print. The week also brings Treasury auctions plus earnings from Constellation Brands, PepsiCo and Delta, offering a read on consumer demand. In Asia on Monday, Japan's Nikkei rose more than 1% as oil flows from the Middle East partly recovered.
news.detailZh: 伊朗战事推高通胀风险，高企的收益率和接近90美元的油价压制美股。疲弱就业数据公布后，市场对美联储10月加息的预期降至约18%-20%。本周还有美债拍卖，以及星座品牌、百事和达美航空财报，可观察消费需求。周一亚洲市场方面，中东石油运输部分恢复，日经指数涨超1%。

news.titleEn: Brazil election headed to runoff, projection shows, as Bolsonaro lead narrows
news.conclusionEn: Brazil's presidential race is heading to an Oct. 25 runoff between President Lula and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after neither cleared 50% in the first round.
news.conclusionZh: 巴西大选无人过半，卢拉与弗拉维奥·博索纳罗将于10月25日决选。
news.whyEn: Brazil is Latin America's largest economy; the outcome will drive the real, Brazilian stocks and fiscal-policy expectations, and is seen as a test of US-China influence in the region.
news.whyZh: 巴西是拉美最大经济体，结果将牵动雷亚尔、巴西股市和财政预期，也关乎中美在拉美的角力。
news.detailEn: With about 85% of votes counted, Flávio Bolsonaro led with roughly 48.5% to Lula's 43.5%, beating many polls, though his lead narrowed as more votes came in. Lula, 80, is seeking a fourth term, while Flávio, 45, is trying to return his father's right-wing movement to power. Brazilian stocks had rallied about 2.6% on the eve of the vote as investors bet on a more market-friendly result. Polls show the runoff as roughly a dead heat, so volatility in the real is likely over the next three weeks.
news.detailZh: 计票约85%时，弗拉维奥以约48.5%对43.5%领先卢拉，表现好于多数民调，但随后领先优势收窄。80岁的卢拉寻求第四个任期，45岁的弗拉维奥则希望让其父亲的右翼阵营重新执政。选前一天巴西股市大涨约2.6%，投资者押注对市场更友好的结果。民调显示决选几乎打平，未来三周雷亚尔可能持续波动。

news.titleEn: OPEC+ agrees to keep November oil output targets steady
news.conclusionEn: Seven core OPEC+ members agreed in a brief online meeting on Sunday to keep oil production targets unchanged for November.
news.conclusionZh: OPEC+核心成员国同意11月产量目标维持不变。
news.whyEn: With Gulf exports disrupted by the Iran war, the decision signals no extra supply relief from producers, leaving price relief to emergency stock releases and a possible Hormuz reopening.
news.whyZh: 海湾出口受战事干扰，产油国不额外增产，油价缓解只能靠战略储备释放和海峡重开。
news.detailEn: The core group includes Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Algeria, Kazakhstan and Oman. Gulf producers have been pumping well below their targets because exports have run at only 60% to 80% of normal levels amid the US-Israeli war on Iran. The group is waiting for a capacity review before deciding how to share future increases, and changes are unlikely before 2027. US crude was trading around $91 a barrel, still far higher than a year ago.
news.detailZh: 核心成员包括沙特、俄罗斯、伊拉克、科威特、阿尔及利亚、哈萨克斯坦和阿曼。受美以对伊战争影响，海湾国家出口仅为正常水平的60%至80%，实际产量远低于目标。该组织在分配未来增产前需等待产能评估结果，2027年前调整的可能性不大。美油价格约91美元/桶，仍远高于一年前。

news.titleEn: Yemeni government launches offensive to seize all areas from Iran-backed Houthis
news.conclusionEn: Yemen's internationally recognized government, backed by the Saudi-led coalition, launched a major offensive to retake all Houthi-held territory.
news.conclusionZh: 也门政府在沙特联军支持下发动大规模攻势，欲夺回胡塞控制区。
news.whyEn: The fighting opens another front in the Iran-linked conflict and has already brought Houthi missile and drone attacks toward Saudi oil facilities, adding to energy supply risk.
news.whyZh: 冲突开辟伊朗相关新战线，胡塞武装已对沙特石油设施发动袭击，加剧能源供应风险。
news.detailEn: The Saudi-led coalition said it carried out 97 targeting operations against Houthi reinforcements on Sunday. The day before, the Houthis claimed missile and drone strikes on Aramco sites in Riyadh and Khurais, which the coalition called misleading. Hostilities restarted after four years of uneasy truce when an Iranian plane flew a Houthi delegation into Sanaa without Saudi authorization. The US has so far said it will not join the offensive.
news.detailZh: 沙特联军称周日对胡塞增援部队执行了97次精确打击。前一天，胡塞武装声称用导弹和无人机袭击了利雅得和胡赖斯的沙特阿美设施，联军称该说法具有误导性。此前一架伊朗飞机未经沙特许可将胡塞代表团送抵萨那，打破了维持四年的脆弱停火。美方目前表示暂不参与此次攻势。

news.titleEn: G7 agrees 100 million-barrel emergency oil release amid US pressure over diesel
news.conclusionEn: G7 countries agreed to release up to 100 million barrels of emergency oil and diesel reserves over four months, coordinated by the IEA.
news.conclusionZh: 七国集团同意4个月内释放最多1亿桶紧急石油和柴油储备。
news.whyEn: The release targets soaring diesel prices that feed into freight, food and inflation, and came under pressure from Washington ahead of US midterm elections.
news.whyZh: 此举针对飙升的柴油价格，影响运输、食品和通胀；美国中期选举前施压促成。
news.detailEn: A substantial amount of diesel will be made available within the first 20 days, according to the G7 statement. The volume is roughly equal to one day of global oil demand. It follows a record 400-million-barrel IEA release agreed in March, more than 80% of which has already been delivered. Analysts question how much it can lower prices while the Strait of Hormuz remains largely shut.
news.detailZh: 据七国集团声明，大量柴油将在前20天内投放。这一规模约相当于全球一天的石油需求。今年3月国际能源署已同意创纪录释放4亿桶，目前已交付超过80%。分析人士质疑，在霍尔木兹海峡基本封闭的情况下，此举能压低多少油价。

news.titleEn: Trump taps Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton as AI czar
news.conclusionEn: Trump named intelligence chief and former SEC chair Jay Clayton as the administration's AI czar to lead a new White House AI task force.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普任命国家情报总监、前SEC主席克莱顿为AI主管。
news.whyEn: AI companies, chipmakers and investors will watch closely: the task force's recommendations could shape federal AI safety rules, procurement and oversight of frontier labs.
news.whyZh: AI企业、芯片商和投资者高度关注，该工作组建议或将影响联邦AI安全监管与采购。
news.detailEn: Clayton was confirmed as Director of National Intelligence in July and previously led the SEC and the Southern District of New York. The new task force has 120 days to report on AI's risks and opportunities and recommend the federal government's role. He will engage with AI companies, consumer and religious groups and other stakeholders. Picking a security and markets veteran suggests the White House is putting more weight on national-security risks from advanced AI.
news.detailZh: 克莱顿于7月获确认出任国家情报总监，此前曾执掌美国证监会及纽约南区联邦检察官办公室。新工作组须在120天内就AI的风险与机遇提交报告，并就联邦政府职责提出建议。他将与AI企业、消费者和宗教团体等各方沟通。选择一位兼具安全与金融监管背景的人，显示白宫更重视先进AI带来的国家安全风险。

news.titleEn: Ukraine robot offensive exposes a vulnerability in Putin's war machine
news.conclusionEn: A Ukrainian offensive around Lyman relying on drones and unmanned ground robots has retaken about 176 square kilometers in the Donbas, experts say.
news.conclusionZh: 乌克兰以无人机和地面机器人为主的攻势在顿巴斯收复约176平方公里。
news.whyEn: It shows robotic warfare reshaping the front line and boosts the case for defense-tech spending, while signaling Russia's territorial push is not unstoppable.
news.whyZh: 显示机器人作战正改变战场，利好国防科技投资，也表明俄军推进并非无法阻挡。
news.detailEn: Dubbed 'Operation Vivaldi,' the push by Ukraine's Third Army Corps began in May and used large bomber drones and remote-controlled robots to strike behind Russian lines. Security experts say it has reversed more than a year of Russian gains in the area, while limiting risk to Ukrainian soldiers. They caution it is not a decisive breakthrough. The results could influence how much military aid Kyiv's partners provide and how Europe allocates defense budgets.
news.detailZh: 这一代号为「维瓦尔第行动」的攻势由乌克兰第三军团自5月起实施，利用大型轰炸无人机和遥控机器人打击俄军后方。安全专家称，此举扭转了俄军在该地区一年多来的推进成果，同时减少了乌军人员伤亡风险。专家也提醒这并非决定性突破。战果可能影响西方伙伴对乌军援力度以及欧洲国防预算的分配。

businessTips.explanationEn: A single-threaded owner is one leader who is responsible for one initiative full-time, rather than juggling it alongside other duties. The idea, popularized at Amazon, holds that important projects stall when ownership is split or treated as a side task. Clear, undivided accountability speeds up decisions and makes it obvious who to ask when something breaks.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「单线程负责人」指由一位负责人全职专注于一个项目，而不是在多项职责之间兼顾。该理念因亚马逊而流行，认为重要项目一旦责任分散或被当作副业，就容易停滞。清晰、不被分割的问责可以加快决策，也让大家一眼知道出了问题该找谁。
businessTips.exampleEn: A company launching a new app assigns one product lead who owns it end to end, with their own engineers and marketer. Instead of waiting for three departments to agree, the lead makes trade-offs and ships weekly.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家公司推出新App时，指定一位产品负责人端到端负责，并配备专属的工程师和市场人员。负责人不必等三个部门达成一致，可以自行权衡取舍，每周迭代上线。

businessTips.explanationEn: A wedge is a narrow, sharp first product that solves one painful problem for a specific group, used to get a foothold before expanding. Instead of building a broad platform from day one, you win a small use case decisively and then add adjacent features. It lowers upfront cost and gives you real customers and data to guide what comes next.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「楔子策略」是指先用一个窄而锋利的产品，为特定人群解决一个痛点，以此打开市场，再逐步扩张。与其一开始就做大而全的平台，不如先在一个小场景里赢得彻底，再延伸到相邻功能。这样前期投入更低，也能用真实客户和数据指导下一步。
businessTips.exampleEn: A freelancer notices Airbnb hosts struggle to schedule cleaners, so they build a simple turnover-scheduling tool first. Once hosts rely on it, they add linen tracking, cleaner payments and supply ordering.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位自由职业者发现Airbnb房东难以安排保洁，于是先做一个简单的退房保洁排班工具。等房东离不开它之后，再加入布草追踪、保洁付款和耗材订购功能。

businessTips.explanationEn: Implied volatility is the market's forecast of how much an asset's price will swing, backed out from option prices. When traders expect a big event such as an election, earnings report or central bank decision, IV rises and options become more expensive. It tells you what the market is already pricing in, not which direction the price will move.
businessTips.explanationZh: 隐含波动率是从期权价格中反推出来的、市场对资产未来波动幅度的预期。当交易者预期有大事发生，例如选举、财报或央行决议时，隐含波动率上升，期权变贵。它反映的是市场已经计入的波动程度，而不是价格会往哪个方向走。
businessTips.exampleEn: Ahead of Brazil's Oct. 25 runoff, options on the Brazilian real are likely to price higher IV than usual. An investor who buys protection now pays a premium for that uncertainty; if the result is a surprise-free outcome, IV can collapse and the option loses value even if the currency barely moves.
businessTips.exampleZh: 在巴西10月25日决选前，雷亚尔期权的隐含波动率很可能高于平时。此时买入保护的投资者要为不确定性支付溢价；如果结果毫无意外，隐含波动率可能骤降，即便汇率几乎没动，期权也会贬值。
